headline: Executive order directs federal agencies to apply sex discrimination protections to gender identity and sexual orientation.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to prevent and fight discrimination based on a person's gender identity or sexual orientation. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, agencies, and programs it covers cannot be confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: The order aims to protect them from discrimination based on their gender identity or sexual orientation.
Agencies are expected to take steps to prevent and address this kind of discrimination.
